releases.summary: Fixed production application redirects and completed Discord OAuth session flow improvements.

changes.description: Fixed post-login redirects so authenticated users are sent to the production application domain instead of falling back to localhost:3000.
Added APP_URL-based application redirects for authenticated dashboard and portal destinations in production deployments.
Updated the Discord OAuth login route to use the configured DISCORD_REDIRECT_URI consistently when constructing the Discord authorization URL.
Updated the OAuth callback to use the configured DISCORD_REDIRECT_URI consistently during authorization-code exchange.
Updated logout handling to redirect users to the configured production APP_URL instead of deriving the destination from the incoming request host.
Applied secure production cookie handling consistently across authentication and logout, including HTTP-only, SameSite, Secure, expiration, and path settings.
Added explicit validation and diagnostics for missing DISCORD_REDIRECT_URI and related OAuth configuration.
Removed unnecessary localhost production fallback behavior from the Discord authentication flow while retaining localhost support as a development fallback where appropriate.

releases.summary: Fixed production Discord OAuth authentication and improved dashboard session handling.

changes.description: Fixed the production Discord OAuth callback to use the configured DISCORD_REDIRECT_URI consistently during authorization-code exchange.
Added robust Discord OAuth callback handling for missing authorization codes, denied authorization, invalid token responses, and failed Discord user lookups.
Improved Discord OAuth token-exchange diagnostics so Discord error responses are logged instead of being reduced to an ambiguous HTTP 400 error.
Corrected Discord OAuth authorization URL construction and removed the production dependency on a localhost redirect URI fallback.
Added explicit validation for required Discord OAuth, guild, and session configuration before processing authenticated requests.
Improved Discord guild membership and owner-role detection during OAuth authentication.
Changed dashboard authentication to use cryptographically random session identifiers stored in HTTP-only cookies instead of exposing Discord user identifiers as session credentials.
Added secure production cookie handling with HTTP-only, SameSite, Secure, path, and expiration settings for dashboard sessions.
Improved OAuth callback logging while avoiding sensitive OAuth tokens and authorization codes in diagnostic output.

releases.summary: Improved shard management, dashboard startup, and subsystem-specific console logging.

changes.description: Added a dedicated dashboard process managed by the Discord shard manager, with optional startup controlled by DASHBOARD_ENABLED.
Separated Discord shard-manager lifecycle handling into dedicated functions for manager creation, shard events, startup, dashboard startup, and graceful shutdown.
Added graceful shutdown handling for SIGINT, SIGTERM, and SIGBREAK, including dashboard termination and Discord shard cleanup.
Added Discord shard lifecycle diagnostics for shard readiness, unexpected process exits, and gateway reconnecting states.
Added automatic Discord shard spawning with configurable TOTAL_SHARDS support while retaining Discord.js automatic shard-count detection when the setting is not provided.

Expanded console logger color mappings with dedicated subsystem colors for the bot, Discord, shard manager, player panel, blueprint panel, commands, components, events, interactions, Dune API, Discord Adapter, and Discord audit logging.
Added dedicated dashboard logging color support so dashboard output can be visually distinguished from Discord and shard-manager logs.
Improved dashboard child-process startup and failure handling so dashboard failures can terminate cleanly without leaving the shard manager running incorrectly.
Updated Discord ready handling to initialize rotating Dune-themed presence messages, start the audit-log forwarder, publish configured panels, and schedule periodic version announcements.

releases.summary: Expanded the private Dune player portal and reorganized dashboard delivery for production use.

changes.description: Added a private Discord-authenticated player portal with character status, level progress, Intel, Solaris Coin, credits, scrip, health, hydration, and spice-addiction indicators.
Added authenticated Hagga Basin map access with real base coordinates, Dune Base.webp markers, zoom controls, panning, fit-to-map behavior, and responsive mobile support.
Added per-base infrastructure summaries using the bases and water endpoints, including water capacity, fuel cells, generator runtime, and 42-day uptime calculations.
Added colored online/offline status indicators and responsive portal controls for Open map and Sign out.
Moved dashboard HTML, CSS, map pages, and static assets into the frontend area while keeping API and OAuth logic in the backend.
Added automatic dashboard frontend installation and build before startup and during Docker image creation.
Fixed Windows npm.cmd startup execution, map iframe localhost failures, stale portal rendering, overflowing progress bars, and unavailable base field fallbacks.

releases.summary: Fixed production release announcements by bundling the changelog with the Docker image.

changes.description: Included CHANGELOG.json in the Docker image at /app/CHANGELOG.json so version announcements can read release history in production.
Synchronized VERSION and package.json to 1.1.4 for the next automated Docker and GitHub release.

releases.summary: Refined administration, community onboarding, release announcements, and environment configuration.

changes.description: Added staff moderation commands for banning, kicking, timing out, and muting members, organized under the moderation command group.
Added a configurable owner-only /reload command under the administration command group.
Added detailed server rules, server information, role selection, membership verification, welcome, and goodbye panels with consistent Components V2 styling.
Added periodic release announcements sourced from CHANGELOG.json, including historical backfill, Discord release timestamps, announcement-role mentions, release images, and GitHub release buttons.
Added Discord audit-log polling with deduplication and forwarding to a dedicated activity-log channel.
Improved console logging with explicit subsystem colors, level colors, a large Arrakis startup banner, quiet dotenv loading, and cleaner startup ordering.
Renamed environment variables to concise names such as TOKEN, CONSOLE_URL, PANEL_CHANNEL_ID, and AUDIT_CHANNEL_ID across source, documentation, and the environment template.
Centralized role definitions and staff authorization helpers, reorganized command folders, and cleaned up application and shard lifecycle code.
Included CHANGELOG.json in the Docker image so automated version announcements can read release history in production.

releases.summary: Expanded community onboarding, role management, server information, and Discord moderation auditing.

changes.description: Added configurable welcome, goodbye, role-selection, verification, rules, and server-information panels with automatic updates instead of duplicate messages.
Added detailed self-assignable playstyle, faction, and notification roles using individual environment-configured role IDs.
Added membership captcha verification with expiring challenges, verification buttons, and automatic verified-role assignment.
Added Crimson Skies server information and detailed community rules Components V2 panels with Dune-themed images.
Added Discord audit-log forwarding through guild.fetchAuditLogs with deduplication and a separate activity-log channel.
Standardized panel colors, embedded images inside Components V2 containers, and added member-avatar artwork to join and leave messages.

releases.summary: Improved source readability and made shard startup easier to maintain.

changes.description: Reformatted the bot source, configuration, documentation, and workflows with consistent spacing and indentation.
Separated shard manager setup, event registration, process handlers, and application startup into clear, maintainable functions.
Kept syntax validation passing after removing ESLint and formatter tooling from the project.
Limited automatic Discord command deployment to the primary shard while continuing to add, update, and remove commands from the live command set.
Added the /purge command for staff-role members to remove up to 100 recent channel messages.
Changed /purge authorization to use the configured staff roles from environment settings instead of Discord permission checks.
Added configurable self-assignable playstyle, faction, and notification role panels with individual role ID settings.
Added a configurable membership captcha panel with verification buttons, expiring challenges, and automatic verified-role assignment.
Added Dune-themed images inside the role and membership verification Components V2 panels.

releases.summary: Prepared the next feature release with improved maintainability and container publishing.

changes.description: Started the 1.1.0 release cycle and synchronized the project version across release metadata.
Normalized the GitHub Container Registry image owner to lowercase so the 1.1.0 Docker release tags are valid.

releases.summary: Added the Advin Convoy VPS API foundation.

changes.description: Added /servers to list authenticated Advin VPS servers through the Convoy API.
Added a grouped Advin Convoy API reference covering authentication, permissions, route families, and safety guidance.
Guarded unsharded Discord client cleanup so early startup failures cannot trigger a secondary 'Shard 0 not found' rejection.
Added an authenticated ConvoyClient for Advin VPS customer API requests, including JSON and PNG responses.
Added optional API_URL and API_KEY configuration and exposed the client on the bot application.

releases.summary: Improved account-linking feedback and command UI consistency.

changes.description: The Link Account button now checks the Discord Adapter first and clearly reports when the user is already linked.
Already-linked users receive a direct Unlink Account action before starting a new link request.
Corrected shared-helper imports in the link button so the bot starts cleanly after deployment.
Successful player verification now grants the configured linked-player role and sets the Discord nickname to the Dune character name.
Added automated source validation so stale syntax issues are caught in CI.
Added focused inline documentation around shared UI factories, API transport, loaders, and application lifecycle ownership.
Added safe link-response diagnostics showing character, status, message, and response fields without logging verification codes.
Improved source documentation guidance for public functions, classes, and methods.
Improved the JavaScript validation configuration for current Node.js releases.
Removed all empty JSDoc placeholders and stopped automated tooling from generating blank documentation blocks.
Added meaningful JSDoc to shared component/image factories, environment loading, and Convoy API transport methods.
Expanded JSDoc coverage across the Dune API facade, blueprint validator, and recursive module discovery utility.
Removed JSDoc blocks and the JSDoc lint dependency for now, leaving the source tree with concise regular comments only.
Added a Discord ShardingManager entrypoint and dedicated shard worker with reconnect, readiness, and process diagnostics.
Removed formatter tooling; validation now uses the lightweight built-in JavaScript syntax check.
Added protected /reload commands, components, and all targets using role 1539721769244565566 for live module refreshes.
Aligned src with the documented Discord bot layout by moving shared UI factories into shared/factories and adding dedicated menus and constants folders.
Added .gitkeep markers to empty menus and shared constants directories so planned extension points remain tracked.
Added Dependabot updates for npm dependencies, GitHub Actions, and Docker base images with grouped pull requests.
Release automation now publishes versioned and latest Docker images to GitHub Container Registry using GitHub Packages.
Cleaned up .env.example into grouped Discord, Console, channel, and diagnostics sections and removed the legacy panel-channel fallback.
Slash commands now use the shared Components V2 response and Dune banner factories.

releases.summary: Improved panel discovery when multiple bot branches share a channel.

changes.description: Expanded /profile with readable currency, Solaris Coin, factions, intel, specs, progression, and vitals data.
Added guild lookup to /profile and display of the linked character's guild name when available.
Added guild-member lookups and full debug responses to reliably identify a player's guild membership.
Removed the character-name filter from guild discovery, matched members by player ID, and corrected the guild_name field shown in /profile.
Enabled safe full debug logging across interactions, Console API requests, and Discord Adapter requests without logging credentials or file contents.
Console API requests now automatically re-authenticate once and retry when the session expires or is lost during bot operation.
Added process-level rejection and exception logging plus timeout-aware network errors for Console API and Discord Adapter requests.
Added Discord gateway reconnect, resume, disconnect, and invalid-session diagnostics plus retries for temporary Console API failures.
Removed the unsupported player stats request and made /profile responses visible in the channel instead of ephemeral.
Cleaned up /profile output by hiding Pawn ID, rounding vitals, and adding a feature flag for future Smuggler faction data.
Added /profile to show the invoking user's linked character through the Discord Adapter actor context; /players remains the server-wide player list.
Panels now find and update their own message by title instead of relying on the latest bot message.
Player-link and blueprint panels can now coexist safely in the same Discord channel.
Added shared Components V2 and Canvas banner factories to reduce duplicated UI construction across commands and panels.
Migrated all slash-command responses to the shared Components V2 response helper and routed command artwork through the centralized Dune banner generator.
Replaced the outdated README with a simpler setup, Docker, release, configuration, and documentation guide.

releases.summary: Fixed the Docker build and GitHub Actions runtime configuration.

changes.description: Corrected the Alpine emoji font package name so Docker images build successfully.
Updated CI and release workflows to use Node.js 24 and removed the Node.js 20 deprecation warning.

releases.summary: Fixed missing fonts in Canvas-generated Discord images.

changes.description: Added fontconfig, DejaVu fonts, and Noto emoji fonts to the Docker image so generated images render Unicode characters and emoji instead of square glyphs.

releases.summary: Removed server-specific Crimson Skies branding from generated command artwork.

changes.description: Replaced hardcoded server branding and asset names with generic Dune Server placeholders.
Clarified that deployment-specific channel IDs belong only in environment configuration.

releases.summary: Organized the source tree and improved blueprint audit logging.

changes.description: Grouped Discord-facing code, infrastructure, reusable modules, and shared helpers into clear source areas.
Blueprint imports now resolve the Console player correctly and use the player pawn ID.
Blueprint audit messages include the uploaded JSON through a Components V2 File component.
Updated project and source-layout documentation.
